**What are you trying to do that duet makes hard?**

Describe the situation rather than the solution first — the useful part is the workflow
you are stuck on.

**What would you want to happen?**

**Would this change what "done" means?** Anything touching the sign-off rules, the gate
or the issue lifecycle needs care: those four rules are the whole product, and loosening
one quietly turns this back into two chatbots agreeing.
